A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same R-SCoRe study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplementary Sections A–C are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original localization experiments on Aachen Day-Night and Hyundai Department Store, including benchmark results, component ablations, and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains those original benchmark and ablation results and additionally reports component-level inference timings in Section 4.3.

M1.justification: The covisibility encoding and augmentation, refinement architecture, depth-adjusted losses, and multiple-hypothesis inference procedure remain unchanged. The revised diagram and width-selection rule clarify the existing method; Appendix A.4 retains the same architectures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Aachen daytime/nighttime localization and Hyundai Department Store floors 1F, 4F, and B1, including the same supplementary validation coverage. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding benchmark and ablation tables. In particular, Neumap remains included in Hyundai validation results in Table 9 and absent from its test-set comparison in Table 3.

E3.justification: The splits, accuracy thresholds, training budgets, and reported model sizes remain unchanged. The count-based width rule and 640 × 480 timing input are newly disclosed details; the PDFs do not establish changes to the existing experimental settings.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 adds a limited efficiency analysis that separates inference cost into retrieval, local encoding, MLP prediction, and pose solving, including timings for alternative encoders and widths. Existing component ablations, hypothesis-count sensitivity, and supplementary training analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version introduces repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. The existing distribution plots and their statistical reporting remain substantively unchanged.

E6.justification: Accuracy and map-size entries in Tables 2–10 are unchanged. v2 adds stage timings, including 7/50 ms for LoFTR/DeDoDe and 70/160 ms for MLP widths 768/1280. The reported total remains 140–270 ms, so this is additional measurement detail rather than an established speed improvement.

T1.justification: The reprojection, depth adjustment, consistency, optional depth-supervision, and covisibility equations retain their mathematical content. Moving the basic regression equation inline causes renumbering. The expanded implicit-triangulation explanation adds no formal assumption, derivation, or proof.

C1.justification: The introduction qualifies the absence of depth and coordinate supervision as scene-specific, modestly narrowing the stated supervision requirement. The main contributions and claims about localization accuracy, compact maps, and avoiding network ensembles remain unchanged.

C2.justification: v2 newly states robustness to reasonable hyperparameter variation in Section 4.3 and removes Section 3.3's specific attribution of global-feature ambiguity to low dimensionality. The conclusion now mentions distribution-shift difficulties, largely reiterating limitations already present in Appendix C.

D1.justification: v2 documents a training-image-count rule for selecting network width, states that extensive hyperparameter tuning was not performed, and specifies the timing input resolution. The abstract changes code release from promised to stated availability at the same repository; availability is not independently verified by the PDFs.

R1.justification: v2 adds Tancik et al.'s Fourier-features paper and connects positional encoding to it and the already-cited NeRF work in Section 3.2. The broader positioning against feature matching, pose regression, and previous SCR methods is retained.

P1.justification: The method overview is rewritten to explain training and inference explicitly, and the implicit-triangulation explanation is expanded and moved into the preliminaries. Additional sentence edits and bibliographic corrections are localized; the overall section structure and supplementary narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The central pipeline visualization is substantially redesigned: v1's single-column Figure 2 becomes a full-width overview plus detailed pipeline, explicitly distinguishing training, testing, losses, retrieval, and pose solving. Several other plots are resized and main-text tables repositioned, while the supplementary displays are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 makes the unchanged method easier to understand through the redesigned Figure 2 and clearer workflow explanation. The width-selection rule, timing breakdown, and more precise supervision claim improve transparency. These are useful but limited gains: benchmark evidence and supplementary analyses remain unchanged, and the new hyperparameter-robustness statement has no accompanying sensitivity sweep.
